summary: Wix's corporate typeface page, built on Wix itself: seven numbered chapters in rounded orange, lilac and green cards, opening on a film in which a single looping Bézier line writes the name. There is no buy or download path; the page closes on an artist video from Wix Playground.

instances.look: WIX logo top-left and a hamburger icon top-right on the hero; the menu lists Introduction, Typetester, Glyphs, Design features, Examples, Signs, Philosophy; attached to the hero, not cut as a block
instances.ux: The burger opens a chapter menu; closed state only in the capture
instances.learn: Numbered chapters in the page pair well with a menu listing them by the same names

reconstruction.layout: Fixed header ~70px, logo 26px from left, icon 26px from right

instances.look: Big orange rounded card on lilac; a thin blue Bézier line with handles loops through it, wrapping into 'Madefor' letters as it goes, while small words ride along the line
instances.feel: A pen drawing the brand in one movement
instances.ux: Loops: flat line with four labels, loops grow, the word is revealed inside them, line straightens, name fully shown, wipes away
instances.learn: One line tying the labels and the letters together shows a typeface's construction and table of contents in a single loop

reconstruction.layout: Lilac 1440×900; card inset 45px sides, top 90px, radius ~130px, about 1350×800, cropped below the fold on capture
reconstruction.typography: 'Madefor' ~210px Madefor Display Regular, black, centred; path text ~12px
reconstruction.behaviour: Muted autoplay looping video drawn via WebGL canvas on Wix; ~20s cycle; the line starts as a straight rule, then each letter appears inside a loop
reconstruction.content: Path labels: 'Our New Custom Typeface', 'Look Inside', 'Let's Get Acquainted', 'For Your Vision'
reconstruction.html: video + canvas.webglcanvas inside a rounded masked container

instances.look: '* 01 Introduction' tiny italic tag with asterisk above a six-line 58px paragraph on lilac
instances.learn: A big asterisk plus a small numbered italic tag works as a repeating section marker

reconstruction.layout: Left text block from x=180, ~790px wide; tag above at y≈100
reconstruction.typography: Tag ~14px Text Italic underlined, with a 30px asterisk; paragraph ~52px Madefor Display Regular, leading ~1.1
reconstruction.content: 'A versatile typographic toolkit with a distinct personality…'

instances.look: A full-width 3-line text area on faint horizontal rules, with the blinking cursor shown: 'Type something here to play with the font.'; a 'Try it out: tap here' prompt above
instances.ux: Click and type up to 45 characters; no toolbar
instances.learn: Ruled lines give an empty tester the feel of writing paper and show the font on a baseline

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed white, three lines at ~148px pitch from x=40
reconstruction.typography: ~125px Madefor Display Regular; rule lines 1px beige/grey at baseline and x-height
reconstruction.behaviour: Text area maxlength=45 with a large typed value; a blinking caret shown by default

instances.look: Left half: blue-ruled 4-column grid of letter pairs (Aa to Zz) with a style dropdown in the first cells; right half: the hovered pair huge on an orange rounded card
instances.ux: Hover a pair to preview it; the dropdown changes the style among nine (Text Regular to Display XBold)
instances.learn: A pair (Ee) rather than a single glyph in the preview shows caps and lowercase together; style selection lives inside the grid

reconstruction.layout: Split 50/50; grid 720px, 4 columns of 180px × 115px rows; the select spans two cells; right card ~630×600, radius ~90px
reconstruction.behaviour: Pairs sit off-centre in their cells in the capture (likely a Wix alignment artefact); hover sets the preview text; select sets font-family of the grid and preview

instances.look: On green: a horizontal strip of huge letter S in each of nine styles, side by side, with tiny captions under each and '← Scroll for more →'
instances.ux: Sideways drag or scroll along the strip
instances.learn: A single characterful letter in a horizontal strip compares styles in less space than a word list

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed green 900px; strip of cells ~250px wide starting at the left edge, overflow-x; caption row below; scroll hint centred
reconstruction.typography: S at ~320px, Text Regular to Display XBold; captions 10px
reconstruction.behaviour: Horizontal overflow; the rounded black card of the next chapter peeks in at the bottom

instances.look: A black rounded card on green: '02 Design Features' prose at left and a huge white 'a' or 'g' with orange Bézier outline and handles at right; the top of the card is cut by the screen split
instances.ux: The glyph video loops, drawing its curves
instances.learn: Use the outline editor's visual language as an image: curves and handles signal craft

reconstruction.layout: Card 1310×~760 with 130px radius centred in green; text column 500px at x=160; video right half
reconstruction.behaviour: Muted looping video in a WebGL canvas
reconstruction.content: 'Madefor combines wide geometric proportions, clean curves, and flaring grotesk terminals…'

instances.look: '03 Examples': a one-sentence pitch at 58px, then a row of rounded photo cards of packaging, books and a specimen, overflowing both edges
instances.ux: Cards extend beyond the screen; likely a horizontal scroller
instances.learn: Bleeding rounded cards past both edges tells the visitor there's more without arrows

reconstruction.layout: Sentence at x=75, 3 lines; row of ~390×400 cards with 30px gaps, radius ~50px
reconstruction.content: 'Madefor represents our natural passion to create products that enable millions to pursue their dreams.'
reconstruction.assets: Three or more studio photos of branded items

reconstruction.layout: 4 columns ~250px from x=50, row pitch ~160px, on a 900px lilac band
reconstruction.typography: ~65px Display XBold, centred in each cell

instances.look: Concentric hairline outlines of an 'O'-like form in black on lilac, closing the Symbols section; the top is cut by a screen boundary
instances.feel: A breath before the philosophy text
instances.ux: Static in the capture; possibly animated
instances.learn: Overlaying all weights of one letter as hairlines makes a calm abstract image

instances.look: '05 The Madefor Philosophy': the same paragraph in several styles in two columns, each with a bold style name and a rotated '16 pt' tag on a vertical rule, ended by a 'More Weights →' rule
instances.ux: 'More Weights' pages through the other styles
instances.learn: Use the brand philosophy as the text sample, so a style list also delivers the message

reconstruction.layout: Two columns ~540px at x=100 and 840; 1px vertical rule at left of each sample; rotated 10px '16 pt' label; rows ~270px
reconstruction.typography: Name 16px Bold; sample 16px in each style, leading ~1.5
reconstruction.behaviour: Click 'More Weights' shows the next batch (nine styles total in the DOM)
reconstruction.content: 'A typeface is the visual personification of your voice…'

instances.look: Full-width autoplay film framed by black: stained-glass arcs with G's and doves around two blue hands touching, Michelangelo-style; other scenes of the film appear in the mobile capture
instances.learn: A commissioned art film gives a corporate typeface a personality that specimen pages can't
